note: Beta-blockade with labetalol (alpha+beta) in cocaine toxicity is debated, so it should not decide the key. Distractor changed to propranolol, a pure nonselective beta-blocker that is clearly avoided.

set.rationales.2: Correct. Propranolol is a pure nonselective beta-blocker; in acute cocaine toxicity it can leave alpha-adrenergic stimulation unopposed, worsening coronary vasospasm and hypertension. Avoid it in the acute phase.
set.takeaway: In acute cocaine toxicity use benzodiazepines and nitroglycerin; avoid pure beta-blockers such as propranolol because of unopposed alpha stimulation.
